title: EdhocInitiator: empty ZeroizeOnDrop does not generate Drop
description:
File: crates/oscore/src/edhoc/initiator.rs
Line: 139
Category: memory-safety

## Description
Empty ZeroizeOnDrop impl does not generate Drop - EdhocInitiator state field containing PRKs is not zeroized on drop. While privkey (SigningKey) and eph_secret (StaticSecret) have their own ZeroizeOnDrop, the InitiatorState containing derived keys is not wiped.

## Fix
Add impl Drop for EdhocInitiator that calls self.zeroize() in the drop method.
